title: Tokyo Night Videography: Low-Light Camera & Video Boost
summary: Photographer Saeka Shimada explores Tokyo at night, demonstrating low-light mobile videography using Video Boost and Night Sight features across Sancha and Shibuya.

events.title: Introduction: Saeka Shimada
events.description: Tokyo photographer Saeka Shimada introduces herself and her creative background.

evidence.quote: My name is Saeka Shimada. I'm a photographer in Tokyo.

events.title: Tokyo City at Night
events.description: Contrasting daytime vs nighttime atmospheres in Tokyo streets.

evidence.quote: Tokyo has many faces. The city at night is totally different from what you see during the day.

events.title: Video Boost & Night Sight
events.description: Demonstrating how computational low-light Night Sight activates during evening recording.

evidence.quote: The new Pixel has a feature called 'Video Boost.' In low light, it activates 'Night Sight' to make the quality even better.

events.title: Sancha Alleyway Memories
events.description: Exploring personal memories while walking through the Sangenjaya neighbourhood.

evidence.quote: Sancha is where I used to live when I first moved to Tokyo. I have a lot of great memories here.

events.title: Filming Puddle Reflections
events.description: Capturing creative low-angle reflection compositions off street puddles.

events.title: Reviewing Low-Light Clarity
events.description: Inspecting captured video playback quality in dark alley conditions.

events.title: Night Shots Montage
events.description: Atmospheric evening scenes and neon lighting across Tokyo alleyways.

events.title: Shibuya Evening Exploration
events.description: Arriving at the iconic Shibuya pedestrian crossing and bridge lights.

transcript.text: My name is Saeka Shimada. I'm a photographer in Tokyo.
Tokyo has many faces. The city at night is totally different from what you see during the day.
The new Pixel has a feature called 'Video Boost.'
In low light, it activates 'Night Sight' to make the quality even better.
Sancha is where I used to live when I first moved to Tokyo. I have a lot of great memories here.
